narrative: On the plot. A sheet nailed to the post, in a clerk's hand, with the company's name and the hour, and no author's name at the foot. On the plot. Blank paper below the player's name, where a book would put a poet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the plot and played the afternoon bill.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Shown on plot in No author on the post
